data.long_meaning: The name Alfonzo is derived from the Old Italian name Alfonso, which is composed of the elements alf (elf, noble) and son (son, descendant). It is also associated with the Italian saint Alfonso Maria de' Liguori (1696-1787), who is the patron saint of moral theologians and confessors.
